description: A feature flag in the license catalog. Managed through the /v3/license/features admin API.

name.description: Internal name of the feature, unique across features and case-insensitive (e.g., "online_scheduling", "3_services_limitation")

description.description: Human-readable description of what the feature controls (e.g., "3 service limitation per account")

packageable.description: Whether the feature may be attached to a package. Only packageable features can be added via POST /v3/license/packages/add_feature (e.g., true, false)

removable.description: Whether the feature can be deleted, which is false while any package uses it (e.g., true, false)

created_at.description: When the feature was created, formatted for display (e.g., "Wed, May 29, 2013 at 12:21pm")

updated_at.description: When the feature was last updated, formatted for display (e.g., "Thu, September 03 at 9:50am")
